claim_boundary: Phase60 characterizes two-flow P1D2/P2D1 communication only on frozen development payload pairs and placements
Phase60 does not train a contention correction, open future blind pairs, choose P/D counts or alter the P1D1 histogram predictor
a Phase51 mismatch is not automatically contention; matched solo anchors must distinguish environment/placement drift
results exclude end-to-end serving, compute, memory feasibility, queueing, unrelated-job congestion, online arrivals and communication-compute overlap

container_contract.required_gpu_class: CUDA GPU with GPUDirect RDMA; the frozen NVIDIA A51 B200 environment is acceptable

development_decision_contract.contention_correction_candidate: matched-solo baseline fails overall or any configuration x topology slice
development_decision_contract.curve_drift_review: Phase51 baseline fails but matched-solo baseline passes; do not mislabel environment/placement drift as contention
development_decision_contract.directly_composable: Phase51 baseline passes overall and every configuration x topology slice
development_decision_contract.evidence_boundary: development physical characterization only; no correction model or blind generalization claim

execution_model: external topology inventory; 24 auditable three-rank GPU measurement shards; deterministic CPU aggregation against frozen Phase51 curves

measurement_contract.data_validation: outside timed intervals verify every byte of the destination region after each mode
measurement_contract.matched_solo_baseline: max(median solo0, median solo1) measured in the same shard; diagnostic separates environment drift from concurrency contention
measurement_contract.official_point_policy: median across repeats within each replica, then maximum concurrent-wave latency across two frozen replicas; never select the faster replica
measurement_contract.phase51_baseline: max(C_model_topology(payload0), C_model_topology(payload1)) using frozen Phase51 official knots
measurement_contract.raw_storage: all per-iteration samples remain outside Git; Git stores compact official points, metrics, audits and raw hashes only
measurement_contract.timed_iteration_rule: clip(floor(512MiB/(payload0+payload1)),5,30); the same count is used for solo0, solo1 and concurrent mode
measurement_contract.wave_latency_semantic: maximum sender-side synchronous call latency across the two concurrently admitted flows; start skew is retained as a diagnostic

objective: 在冻结P1D1消息预测链和Phase51单链路物理曲线的前提下，使用生产Mooncake RDMA实测P1D2 fan-out与P2D1 fan-in两路同wave传输，判断P1D1曲线是否可直接组合，并为后续轻量contention修正保留不含未来blind标签的development物理数据。

pair_grid_contract.pair_order: flow0 page count, flow1 page count
pair_grid_contract.policy: Phase60 may measure development_pairs only; reserved_future_blind_pairs must not be measured or opened until a later workflow freezes the correction model

research_scope.decision_scope: none; P/D counts, routing and topology are fixed inputs
research_scope.routing: two distinct logical KV chunks; P1D2 maps flow0/flow1 from one P endpoint to two D endpoints; P2D1 maps one flow from each P endpoint to a shared D endpoint
research_scope.wave_admission: all ranks and both logical transfers are ready before a synchronized release; no request is duplicated

stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not the exact W60 supplied to the runner or pinned inputs differ
topology plan is not frozen before raw or topology labels use benchmark speed
any model x configuration x topology x replica shard is unavailable
production Mooncake batch_transfer_sync, RDMA or dma-buf is unavailable or concurrent calls return failure
execution falls back to TCP, MNNVL, intranode NVLink path, staging or custom memory pool
reserved future blind payload pairs are measured
model weights, inference, training, prediction labels, protected raw/cache/PID assets or network downloads are accessed
raw samples would enter Git or an existing result directory would be overwritten
topology_classification_policy: host/rack/fabric identity and A-to-B direction freeze before raw; labels must not be inferred from latency, bandwidth or benchmark output

topology_definitions.L1: four frozen endpoint slots on one host/rack; each three-rank shard uses three distinct GPUs and Mooncake remains RDMA
topology_definitions.L2: two endpoint slots on side A host and two on side B host; hosts are distinct but in one rack/network domain
topology_definitions.L3: two endpoint slots on side A host and two on side B host; hosts are in different racks but one RDMA network domain

transport_contract.concurrent_call_policy: P1D2 uses two Python worker threads calling one shared production MooncakeTransferEngine on disjoint registered regions; P2D1 uses one production engine on each P rank; all calls remain synchronous production batch_transfer_sync
transport_contract.native_behavior_policy: the workflow records production behavior including serialization or contention; it must not replace the wrapper or backend to manufacture overlap
